The template is optional; do not use the KTH logo. The 12 October 2026, 23:59 due date is the bonus cutoff for the 19 October exam. Canvas separately locks submissions on 31 January 2027 at 23:59; that later lock does not extend bonus eligibility. The report is required laboratory coursework, distinct from the optional bonus timing.
